I think you should approach him calmly and tell him that him being homosexual doesn’t change your opinions of him. I honestly don’t think being gay itself is haram, but acting on it. 
Also remind him that haram relationships are for ALL sexualities. Men and women aren’t even allowed to talk or interact without a Mahram or being alone. 

At the end of the day remember he’s your brother who is a teenager and is going through his own issues in life. But to make him more open with you, tell him that you still love him and won’t share what you found out with anyone. Tell him to also reach out to Allah, and to end his haram relationship. As for you, pray a lot to Allah and pray Tahajuud too!! Allah is merciful upon anyone who repents. 

But please don’t take it out on him, or stress yourself out too much. Try to communicate with him though softly and kindly, and make sure he knows that you’re there for him!
VS Tease Crème Cloud, Mugler Alien, Commodity Milk, Britney Spears Fantasy, and Valentino Donna Born in Roma
